criticalImplementationNotes: Scrambled formats (indala27_asc, tecom27) require bit lookup tables
Interleaved parity (corp1000_35, corp1000_48, hid_siemens_36) needs new parity function
Multi-row parity (h10320_clockdata, w28_2804) needs 3 separate parity calculations
XOR checksum (hid_honeywell_40) needs byte XOR function
Issue level formats need API extension for 3rd field
Government formats (TWIC, PIV) need 5-7 input fields

notes: All bit counts include parity bits where applicable
Facility codes may be called 'site codes' in some systems
Card numbers may be called 'badge numbers' or 'ID numbers'
Wavelynx formats (wl*) are based on official Wavelynx documentation
CSN formats have no parity or facility code - just raw card serial numbers
Tech Code fields identify credential technology type (used by Wavelynx)
Mobile credential formats (SEOS, MyPass) may require encrypted communication
Formats marked 'isNew: true' are from EverythingID source
Formats marked 'fixedFrom' had discrepancies corrected from v4.0
Some formats have 'scrambled: true' indicating non-sequential bit ordering
